programme.title: Dambusters Declassified
programme.desc: Martin Shaw takes a fresh look at one of the most famous war stories of them all. The actor, himself a pilot, takes to the skies to retrace the route of the 1943 raid by 617 Squadron which used bouncing bombs to destroy German dams. He sheds new light on the story as he separates the fact from the myth behind this tale of courage and ingenuity.

programme.title: Berlusconi: Condemned to Win
programme.desc: Fabio Capello leads Milan to a new era of glory, while Berlusconi steps onto Italy's political stage, ushering in a turbulent new chapter in the nation's politics.

programme.title: Lost Cities of The Ancients
programme.desc: This is the story of the formidable Hittites and their long-lost capital, Hattusha, which has recently been rediscovered. Buried in this lost city is one of the greatest libraries of the ancient world, and all the secrets of this mysterious civilisation were written in two codes - one a unique form of hieroglyphs with which we can recreate the lost world of the Hittites.

programme.title: From Ice to Fire: The Incredible Science of Temperature
programme.desc: Dr Helen Czerski ventures to the bottom of the temperature scale, revealing how cold has shaped the world around us and why frozen doesn't mean what you might think.

programme.title: The Ruth Ellis Files: A Very British Crime Story
programme.desc: In April 1955 Ruth Ellis shot her lover David Blakely dead. It's a case that shocked the nation and it still fascinates today. It has its place in ushering in the defence of diminished responsibility and the abolishment of capital punishment.

programme.title: Roy Clarke Remembers... A Foreign Field
programme.desc: Writer Roy Clarke tells the story of how 'A Foreign Field', his one-off drama telling the story of war veterans returning to the beaches of France, came to life and featured Sir Alec Guinness, Jeanne Moreau and Lauren Bacall.

programme.title: Screen One
programme.desc: Cyril and Amos, two veterans of the Normandy landings, return to France to visit the grave of their wartime friend. They encounter Waldo, an American on a similar mission, and the meeting sparks memories of an old girlfriend from the past. With the mysterious American Lisa in their wake, Cyril and Waldo decide to try to track her down.

programme.title: How to Get Ahead
programme.desc: Stephen Smith explores the flamboyant Baroque court of the Sun King, Louis XIV. Louis created the Palace of Versailles so he could surround himself with aristocrats, artists, interior designers, gardeners, wigmakers, chefs and musicians. Hordes of ambitious courtiers scrambled to get close to the king, but unseemly goings-on in the royal bedchamber reflected the quickest path to power.

programme.title: Florence Nightingale: Nursing Pioneer
programme.desc: A look at the life of Florence Nightingale, a trailblazer who revolutionised modern nursing. Born into a rich English family, Nightingale broke through social and gender barriers to pioneer a profession previously reserved for men.

programme.title: Personal Cinema: Maggie Smith

programme.title: Tea With Mussolini
programme.desc: Florence 1935. A circle of English ladies settled in the cultured city take an orphan boy, Luca, under their wing. programme.title: Hot Chocolate at the BBC
programme.desc: Errol Brown, who died aged 71 in May 2015, was probably the most famous and ubiquitous black British pop star of the 70s and early 80s. This compilation of BBC performances and rare interview extracts celebrates Errol and 'Hot Chocolate', showcasing their top ten hits alongside rarely seen early performances and cult fan favourites.

programme.title: When Bob Marley Came to Britain
programme.desc: Featuring rarely-seen archive and interviews with people who met him, this documentary examines Marley's special relationship with Britain and reveals how his presence helped influence British politics, culture and identity during a time of massive social and civil unrest in the UK, and how his universal message of one love and unity helped inspire a generation of Black British youth.

programme.title: Bob Marley Reimagined
programme.desc: Celebrate the rich legacy of reggae legend Bob Marley in a concert filmed live at Birmingham Town Hall, featuring some of his most celebrated songs and special guests including his grandson Skip Marley.

programme.title: Reggae at the BBC
programme.desc: An archive celebration of great reggae performances filmed in the BBC Studios, drawn from programmes such as 'The Old Grey Whistle Test', 'Top of the Pops' and 'Later... with Jools Holland', and featuring the likes of Bob Marley and the Wailers, Gregory Isaacs, Desmond Dekker, Burning Spear, Althea and Donna, Dennis Brown, Buju Banton and many more.

programme.desc: Bringing the best in television.

programme.title: Og y Draenog Hapus
programme.desc: Beth sy'n digwydd ym myd Og a'i ffrindiau heddiw? What's happening in the world of Og and friends?

programme.title: Chwedlau Tinga Tinga
programme.sub-title: Pam Fod Gan Galago Lygaid Mawr
programme.desc: There was a time when Bushbaby didn't have big eyes. She had tiny little eyes, and she was always getting lost. Strange things began to happen and there are stories that Majitu the Great Giant has returned to Tinga Tinga.

programme.title: Sigldigwt
programme.desc: Ysgol Pwll Coch sy'n help yng Ngwesty Sigldigwt heddiw a byddwn yn cwrdd ag Annie a Megan sy'n berchen ceffylau. We meet Annie and Megan who both own horses.

programme.title: Sion Y Chef
programme.desc: Siôn wants to make apple fool for his special of the day, but when goat Menna eats all the apples he has to find a replacement ingredient.

programme.title: Bendibwmbwls
programme.desc: Mae Ben Dant ar antur ailgylchu. Heddiw bydd e'n ymuno á disgyblion Ysgol Bodringallt i greu trysor ailgylchu penigamp. Ben Dant joins Ysgol Bodringallt pupils to make a recycled treasure.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion ledled Cymru yn ei Gaban Banana, ac yn trafod Anifeiliaid Anwes gyda'r plant. Pets are the topic of discussion for Gareth and the children.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae pawb yn Ocido'n teimlo'n flinedig iawn felly mae Blero'n darganfod sut mae bwyd yn rhoi egni i ni. Everyone in Ocido is feeling very tired, Blero learns how food gives us energy!

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Nel eisiau gwybod o ble mae caws yn dod. Felly, mae Hywel y ffermwr hud yn mynd â hi i Fferm Fach er mwyn dangos hud ffermio iddi. Nel wants to know where cheese comes from, so Hywel the magic farmer shows her.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.desc: Mae gan Pablo ei ffordd ei hun o weld y byd. Heddiw mae'r niwl yn gwneud i bopeth edrych yn llwyd. Sut all Pablo a'r criw ddod a lliw yn ol i'w byd? The fog is making everything look grey, so Pablo needs to colour the fog!

programme.title: Dreigiau Cadi
programme.desc: Mae Bledd a Cef yn penderfynu helpu Mr Jenkins trwy newid y llwybr cerdded mewn i llinell syth fel heolydd y Rhufeiniaid. Roman re-enactors visit the railway, and the Dragons want to help!

programme.title: Cywion Bach
programme.desc: Antur geiriau gyda'r Cywion Bach wrth iddyn nhw ddysgu gair arbennig - Awyren. A word adventure with the Cywion Bach as they learn a special word today - Awyren (Aeroplane).

programme.title: Sam Tân
programme.desc: Mae'n ddiwrnod sioe Arddangos Llysiau Gorau Pontypandy. Mae'r plant wedi tyfu pwmpen enfawr ond mae Jams a hi yn cael antur a hanner! It's Pontypandy's Best Vegetable Show day. The children have grown a huge pumpkin.

programme.title: Cacamwnci
programme.desc: Cyfres gomedi i blant meithrin sy'n cynnwys sgetsys, eitemau doniol, jôcs a chymeriadau dwl iawn. A comedy show for pre-school children, full of sketches, jokes, fun, monkey nonsense and great new comedy characters.

programme.title: Digbi Draig
programme.desc: Mae Cochyn a Betsi yn helpu Digbi i lanhau ei ogof. A fydd swyn yn helpu? Cochyn and Betsi are helping Digbi clean his cave, which has become very messy. They see if a little magic will help.

programme.title: Amser Maith Maith Yn Ol
programme.desc: Stori o dros gan mlynedd yn ôl adeg y Rhyfel Byd Cyntaf' sydd gan Tadcu heddiw. Mae Tomi a Gwen wedi bod yn gofalu am eu llysiau yn ofalus iawn ar gyfer y gystadleuaeth arddio. Mrs Parri yw'r beirniad ac mae hi wedi ymweld a phob gardd yn y pentre er mwyn dod o hyd i enillydd. Today Grandad has a story from over one hundred years ago, during the First World War. Tomi and Gwen have been looking after their vegetables carefully and are preparing for the garden competition.

programme.title: Anifeiliaid Bach y Byd
programme.desc: Yn y rhaglen hon, coesau yw'r thema a cawn gipolwg ar yr octopws, y neidr gantroed a'r tarantiwla. The theme this time is legs, and we meet the octopus, the centipede and the tarantula.

programme.title: Octonots
programme.sub-title: Yr Octonots a Dirgelwch yr Octofad
programme.desc: After the Octopod breaks down, Ira knows that the only way to get the new part that she needs is to take a trip to the old Octopod. But they may not be alone on their abandoned ship.

programme.title: Odo
programme.desc: Cartwn hyfryd am gwdihw bach o'r enw Odo a'i ffrindiau yn y goedwig. A little owl called Odo and his woodland friends aim to combat the rise of anxiety in pre-school children by teaching them self-efficacy and to believe in themselves.

programme.title: Joni Jet
programme.desc: Pan aiff Jet-fam i hedfan efo Jetboi, ceisia Joni wneud popeth y ffordd 'iawn', gan amau ei fod ar brawf. When Jet-mom goes to fly with Jet-boy, Joni tries to do it all the right way.

programme.title: Kim a Cai a Cranc
programme.desc: Ymunwch â Kim a Cai ar antur hudolus sy'n llawn dawns a cherddoriaeth, wrth iddyn nhw chwilio am gragen newydd i Cranc. Join Kim and Cai as they search for a new shell for Cranc.

programme.title: Caban Banana Gareth yr Orangutan
programme.desc: Mae Gareth yr Orangutan yn teithio ysgolion ledled Cymru yn trafod amryw bynciau. Wythnos yma, Anifeiliaid Anwes ydi'r pwnc trafod. This week, pets is the topic of discussion.

programme.title: Blero Yn Mynd I Ocido
programme.desc: Mae Blero'n diodde' o binnau bach yn ei draed, sy'n creu helynt yng nghystadleuaeth Sefyll yn Stond Ocido. Blero gets pins and needles and causes chaos at the musical statues competition.

programme.title: Fferm Fach
programme.desc: Mae Guto eisiau gwybod o ble ddaw lafant, felly mae Hywel, y ffermwr hud, yn mynd ag ef i Fferm Fach er mwyn dangos hud ffermio go iawn. Guto wants to know where lavender comes from.

programme.title: Pablo
programme.sub-title: Hwyl Fawr Hwyl Fawr Hwyl Fawr
programme.desc: Nid yw Pablo'n deall pam fod y Fiona yn dal i siarad ar ol dweud 'Hwyl fawr'. Pablo doesn't understand why Fiona is still talking to mum after she has already said goodbye.
